slot.brief: Complete the reaction: diborane with water / with LiH / with HCl — pick the products of a given diborane reaction.

stem:
Diborane undergoes complete hydrolysis:
B2H6 + 6 H2O -> ?
Which option gives the correct products?

verdicts.working: Complete hydrolysis forms boric acid and hydrogen: B₂H₆ + 6H₂O → 2H₃BO₃ + 6H₂. This is balanced.

working:
B2H6 + 6 H2O -> 2 H3BO3 + 6 H2. Water cleaves the electron-deficient B-H-B bridges, giving boric acid and dihydrogen.

Independent check: Complete hydrolysis forms boric acid and hydrogen: B₂H₆ + 6H₂O → 2H₃BO₃ + 6H₂. This is balanced.
solution:
On complete hydrolysis, diborane forms boric acid and hydrogen.
$$\mathrm{B_2H_6 + 6H_2O \rightarrow 2H_3BO_3 + 6H_2}$$
The equation is balanced.
